results.corrected_title: Gottheimer and Moran introduce bipartisan Recursive Self-Improvement Safety Act
results.corrected_summary: Reps. Josh Gottheimer (D-NJ) and Nathaniel Moran (R-TX) introduced the Recursive Self-Improvement Safety Act on Nov 24, 2026. It would require quarterly reports on AI involvement and human oversight in AI development from the largest developers, to a proposed Office of Frontier Artificial Intelligence Research at the Commerce Department. False or incomplete reports could bring civil penalties of up to $10M. The bill still has to pass committee and both chambers.
key_facts: Covered developers: above a compute threshold and at least $100M spent on training in the previous year
Quarterly reports to a proposed Office of Frontier AI Research at Commerce

results.corrected_title: Oslo AI debt-collection startup Audun raises $3M
results.corrected_summary: Audun, an Oslo-based AI debt collection startup founded in June 2026, raised $3M. Investors include Alliance VC and Y Combinator, plus Robinhood Ventures, Skyfall, First Degree and angel investors. It is expanding to Sweden first, with more international expansion planned for next year.
key_facts: Investors: Alliance VC, Y Combinator, Robinhood Ventures, Skyfall, First Degree and angels
